title: Indian-Style Burger
description: A unique twist on a classic burger, featuring Indian-inspired flavors. Perfect for adventurous eaters looking to spice up their meal routine.

ingredients.name: stir-fried onions
ingredients.notes: adds a sweet and crunchy texture

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.notes: adds a warm and earthy taste

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Cook the burger patty to desired doneness, about 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Meanwhile, toast the bun by grilling it lightly or baking it in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Stir-fry the onions in a little oil until they're soft and lightly browned.
Assemble the burger by spreading fry sauce on the bottom bun, followed by the cooked patty, stir-fried onions, and finally the top bun.
Sprinkle minced garlic and a pinch of cumin and coriander on top for added flavor.
